text:
Liam Patel: Quick heads-up — CloudMart asked for a pinning + rollback plan for the marketplace image release tomorrow AM. We discovered a perf regression on A100 with CUDA 12.4 during our quant kernel runs.

Maya Chen: Noted. Do we have a repro and raw numbers?

Rajesh Kapoor: Short excerpt from the nightly perf run:
```
model: gpt-medium-quant
hw: a100-40gb
cuda: 12.4
avg_token_ms: baseline 1.8ms -> 2.6ms (+44%)
critical_kernel: matmul_qint8
```

Liam Patel: Oof. That aligns with CloudMart's early canary notes — they saw higher tail latency. Kevin, can you share their exact image config?

Kevin (CloudMart): image: cloudmart/gpu-runtime:2026-03-20-prod
cuda: 12.4, driver: 535.54, cudnn: 8.10
We flagged it to infra; their perf team will repro later today.

Silicor Eng: We ran the same workload on our silico lab. Preliminary: driver 535.54 had a kernel schedule change that can regress quant kernels in some tiled matmul paths. We're validating a micro-patch.

Ana Rivera (MatrixSI): MatrixSI runs the integrator images for a few customers. We saw similar regressions on NGC-like stacks. Can we pin to driver 525.x for marketplace images until Silicor patch is validated?

Maya Chen: Pinning to 525.x is safe for most models but we need to check compatibility window for CUDA 12.4 users. Also need to confirm Marketplace artifact signing won't block a pin.

Liam Patel: Proposal:
- Freeze marketplace image rollout for 12.4 driver variants (hold new uploads)
- Create a canary lane: image with driver=525.85 + CUDA12.4 to validate perf parity
- Silicor to provide micro-patch or a recommended driver ABI to re-run tests
- Ops run rollback playbook if partner images hit production degradation
Assign owners: Maya (internal test + canary), Kevin (cloud partner comms), Silicor Eng (patch + validation), Ana (SI integration checks).

Maya Chen: I'll spin up canary tests and post results in this thread by EOD. Should we also add a perf regression alert to the Console?

deploy-bot: Canary pipeline triggered: canary/gpu-runtime-525-cuda12.4 -> job 7865 started.

Rajesh Kapoor: If we see kernel-level variance, we may add a temporary kernel fallback: set IPEX/quant matmul path selector to prefer stable kernel. That buys time.

Silicor Eng: ETA on micro-patch: 24-36h. We'll aim for a build and test matrix on A100 and H100 variants. Sharing internal PR link once ready.

Kevin (CloudMart): I'm telling CloudMart PMs we'll pause the rollout and coordinate a joint statement if needed. Please give me a one-line pin summary for marketplace docs.

Liam Patel: One-line for docs: "Marketplace images temporarily pin GPU driver to 525.x for CUDA 12.4 workloads pending validation of 535.x kernel regressions; recommended canary lanes available."

Ana Rivera (MatrixSI): Can we add a note for SI customers: "If you depend on quantized kernels, hold upgrade until validated" — Matrix will echo this to our integrations channel.

Maya Chen: OK starting canary now. Tests: perf, tail-latency p99, and token throughput. I'll paste results.

Rajesh Kapoor: Also adding a small eval set to catch quality regressions from quant kernel changes (just in case).

Liam Patel: Thanks all. Next sync: 09:30 UTC tomorrow unless we get Silicor patch earlier. If patch arrives sooner, we'll fast-track validation and update CloudMart.

Silicor Eng: We'll aim for a PR by tomorrow morning UTC and notify here.

Kevin (CloudMart): Appreciated — I'll hold marketplace approvals and prep comms.

deploy-bot: Canary job 7865: build 1 completed, perf tests queued.

Maya Chen: First quick numbers look promising (525 pin): avg_token_ms ~1.82ms, p99 down ~5% vs 535 run. I'll upload full logs shortly. :thumbsup:

Liam Patel: Great. Filing this as an action item for the partnership runbook. We'll draft a short joint announcement template if rollback becomes public-facing.

Ana Rivera (MatrixSI): Adding MatrixSI ops contact to the runbook: ops@matrixsi.com (for handoffs).

Liam Patel: Closing for now — update thread when Silicor PR and the full canary logs are in. Thanks everyone.
